title: Shop Local Vendor Markets Presented by Comerica
description: Monthly | 10 AM – 2 PM Discover one-of-a-kind finds at our Shop Local Vendor Markets, presented by Comerica Bank. With a curated lineup of local artisans, handmade goods and unique finds, it’s the perfect way to support small! Remaining 2026 Market Dates: September 19 October 17 November 28 Parking : The parking garage is located at 6605 Warren Parkway, right next to the playground. Self-parking is also available at 3011 Internet Blvd. and 3010 Gaylord on either side of the Park, in addition to the spots around the Park Vendors interested in participating can find more information and sign up here .

title: Kaleidoscope Christmas
description: Celebrate the season at Kaleidoscope Park’s Annual Christmas Tree Lighting, featuring live reindeer, performances by local schools, seasonal treats, a visit from Santa Claus, photo ops and a beautiful tree lighting ceremony that brings the Park to life with twinkling lights and festive music! We'll end the night with an Emerald City band concert! It’s the perfect way to kick off the holiday season with family and friends. Parking: You may park in the parking garage located at 6605 Warren Parkway, right across from the playground, or the open spots surrounding the Park. A map and additional parking can be found HERE . Vendors: If you’re interested in participating as a vendor, please email us here . Sponsors: interested in sponsorship opportunities (including in-kind), please email cdudley@kaleidoscopepark.org

title: Monthly Date Night
description: Make your date night unforgettable with a lively and FREE evening designed for connection, creativity, and a little friendly competition. Enjoy great music, BYOB, and interactive experiences like wine tastings, crafting activities, lawn games, and more – perfect for quality time with your favorite person! To make the night even more special, visitors can help build our music playlist. Have a favorite love song or date-night anthem you’d like us to play? Send your song request to info@kaleidoscopepark.org and we’ll add it! November: Chalk Art December: Stargazing WHO: 18+ Friends of the Park Members (at the $500+ level) receive a complimentary wine pour. Parking: The parking garage is located at 6605 Warren Parkway, right next to the playground. Self-parking is also available at 3011 Internet Blvd. and 3010 Gaylord on either side of the Park, in addition to the spots around the Park. RSVP for November 7th here: https://cftexas.jotform.com/form/date-night-sign-up-11-7

title: Dia de los Muertos
description: Join us for a FREE evening of culture, remembrance, and celebration as Kaleidoscope Park honors Día de los Muertos. Experience music and performances, explore community ofrendas, family-friendly activities, and a stunning Catrina Fashion Show showcasing the artistry, elegance, and traditions inspired by this cherished holiday. Gather with family and friends as we celebrate the lives, stories, and legacies of loved ones in a colorful and welcoming community celebration. Parking: The parking garage is located at 6605 Warren Parkway, right next to the playground. Self-parking is also available at 3011 Internet Blvd. and 3010 Gaylord on either side of the Park, in addition to the spots around the Park. Valet parking is available at Hall Park Hotel

title: Diwali
description: The Festival of Lights is coming to the heart of Frisco — and YOU are invited to be part of the magic! On November 1st, Kaleidoscope Park in Frisco transforms into a spectacular celebration of culture, music, dance, lights and a drone show! *REGISTRATION IS MANDATORY* Please register at: www.friscodiwali.org *Disclaimer: Kaleidoscope Park serves as the location for this event; however, the event is organized, operated, and managed by a third-party entity. Kaleidoscope Park Foundation is not responsible for event production, including but not limited to content, activities, registration, ticketing or communications related to this event. All questions should be directed to the event organizer.

title: MindTravel Silent Piano Concert
description: MindTravel brings its live-to-headphones 'silent' piano concert to Kaleidoscope Park this November! Join us for music + mindfulness! MindTravel Live-to-Headphones: Immersive Piano Concert A mindful music experience by composer & pianist Murray Hidary Slip on wireless headphones and be transported by MindTravel’s signature live-to-headphones “silent” piano journey. Composer and pianist Murray Hidary creates an unforgettable evening of soothing, improvisational music designed to quiet the mind, open the heart, and connect you more deeply to yourself and those around you. Event Details When: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 • 6:00PM (arrive 20–30 minutes early for check-in) Where: Kaleidoscope Park, (on the grass at the Arts Plaza) Frisco, TX Tickets: Limited headphones available — reserve yours in advance What You’ll Experience -A live, one-of-a-kind piano performance delivered directly through premium wireless headphones -A mindfulness-infused concert that brings you into presence and clarity -A shared, screen-free gathering that fosters expansion, connection, and healing Who It’s For -Music lovers and creatives seeking inspiration -Wellness and mindfulness seekers looking to reset -Meditators (new or seasoned) ready to deepen their practice -Couples, friends, or solo adventurers looking for a unique and meaningful night out What to Bring -A blanket, low chair, or cushion (seating is not provided) -A light layer for cooler temperatures -Water to stay hydrated -An open mind and heart Good to Know - Rain or shine. For light rain, the event continues. In cases of severe weather, we’ll notify ticket holders by email with updates. - Check in early. Headphones are limited and distributed upon arrival. - Family-friendly. Guests should be comfortable sitting quietly for the duration. � Don’t miss this chance to experience live MindTravel in person. Space is limited, and tickets go quickly — reserve yours today and step into a powerful journey of music and mindfulness. What People Are Saying " MindTravel is an experience like no other. Imagine a concert pianist improvising beautiful, peaceful music with imagery in the background that matches the beauty of the music — combined, it is almost meditative or trancelike." - Jason Wachob, Founder of mindbodygreen " MindTravel is an amazing introduction to meditation as it takes the Traveler on a specific journey. It is also perfect for the experienced meditator as a way to enhance and deepen one’s own practice. In short, Mind Travel is for anyone!” - Sara Ivanhoe, MA Yoga Philosophy More about MindTravel Founded by composer and pianist Murray Hidary, MindTravel is an immersive, live-to-headphones musical journey that turns the universal language of emotion into a pathway to presence, insight, and awakening. Staged in remarkable settings—from Middle Eastern deserts to Antarctic ice and beaches in between—MindTravel invites us to listen deeply and remember what’s always available: connection to ourselves, to Nature, and to our shared humanity. Come as you are. Leave more connected.

title: Heritage How-To: Calligraphy with Gaurii S Kumaar
description: Discover the timeless art of beautiful writing in this beginner-friendly calligraphy workshop! Learn the fundamentals of modern calligraphy, including proper pen techniques, basic strokes, letter formation, and how to connect letters into elegant words and phrases. With step-by-step guidance, you'll build confidence as you create your own handwritten designs perfect for greeting cards, journals, gift tags, place cards, and other personalized projects. Whether you're looking to develop a new creative hobby or refine your lettering skills, this relaxing, hands-on workshop is the perfect place to get started. All supplies are provided, and you'll take home your practice materials and finished creations to continue your calligraphy journey.

title: Community Clean-Up & Bluebonnet Planting
description: Join us as we roll up our sleeves, clean up our shared space, and plant a beautiful, water-wise spring bloom.How the Cleanup Works Supplies Provided: We will have grabber tools, safety vests, gloves, black trash bags, and clear recycling bags ready for you at the check-in table.Sorting Matters: We will be strictly separating trash into the black bags and plastics/aluminum into the clear bags.Bag Drop: Once your bag is full, you will leave it tied up at our designated trail-edge drop zones. The City of Frisco Environmental Services team will swing by to collect them after the event.What to Wear: Please wear closed-toe shoes, comfortable clothes you don't mind getting dirty, and bug spray.

title: Illuminate: Magic & Mayhem
description: Step into the hauntingly beautiful glow of Magic and Mayhem: The Music of Villains, a candlelight concert inside the historic Lebanon Chapel. Hundreds of flickering candles set the stage for an enchanting evening where eerie string melodies and dramatic piano compositions bring the most iconic villain themes to life. As shadows dance along the chapel’s walls, guests will be immersed in a spellbinding symphony of magic and mystery, featuring beloved scores that evoke power, intrigue, and a touch of wicked charm.

title: Illuminate: Christmas Movie Classics
description: Christmas Movie Classics will surround guests with the nostalgic glow of candlelight as beloved music from iconic holiday films fill the room. This festive performance blends timeless cinematic melodies with the cozy charm of the season, creating an atmosphere that feels both magical and familiar. From whimsical tunes to heartfelt favorites, the concert invites audiences to relive cherished Christmas moments through the power of music.

title: Pumpkin Dunk
description:
Swim in the Indoor Aquatic Center at the FAC and "pick" a pumpkin from our floating pumpkin patch! Paint and decorate your pumpkin and take it home to display for the season.

Admission for this special event includes one pumpkin per person, pumpkin decorating, swimming, face painting, and candy. Advance registration is not required.

This event is free for FAC members!

Day Pass purchase required for non-members. Passes can be purchased at the front desk of the FAC on the day of the event or anytime during normal hours.

Thank you to our sponsors for encouraging play!

description: Join Play Frisco's Cultural Affairs Manager to discus Frisco news and updates as we work towards creating a city where arts, culture, and community thrive together. Learn more about Coffee & Culture.

title: Heritage How-To: Collage with Zahra Jahanyfard
description: Bring your creativity to life in this hands-on collage-making class! Learn techniques for layering, composition, color, and texture to create a collage that truly pops while still feeling cohesive and balanced. Experiment with a variety of materials and discover how to combine different images, patterns, and elements into a unique work of art. Whether you’re new to collage or looking to expand your creative skills, this class is a fun opportunity to cut, layer, and create!

title: Rail District Celebration at 4th Street Plaza
description:
Celebrate the heart of Frisco and the opening of new community spaces in the Rail District! Explore the new 4th Street Plaza, park in the new 5-story parking garage, listen to live music, and shop at Rail District businesses.

6 p.m. - Ribbon cutting ceremony at the 4th Street Plaza stage.

6:30 to 9 p.m. - Live music & performances on the stage

7 p.m. - Plated: A Chef's Table on Main (Tickets required)

8 p.m. - Drone show over the Rail District

9 p.m. - All festivities conclude

We can't wait to celebrate this special part of our city with y'all!

Texas's own Cherry Bomb is the quintessential tribute to the Women of Rock. Since 2015, they have blazed a rock and roll trail across the Southwest, wowing audiences with high energy performances and incredible musicianship. Cherry Bomb brings to life the biggest hits from the greatest voices of the 70s, 80s, and 90s, along with the one-hit wonders everybody loves and remembers. They are bringing the show to 4th Street Plaza to open the new community space with a bang!

title: Walnut Wednesday: Nature Adventure
description: Roll up your sleeves for interactive crafts and activities that bring the prairie to life this Walnut Wednesday! Join us to make tree‑ring necklaces, create your own nature journal, craft seed balls, and explore our collection of animal skins and skulls. It’s a hands‑on adventure for all ages!

title: Heritage Halloween
description:
Join the holiday fun at the annual Heritage Halloween event!

Heritage Halloween brings kid-friendly spooky fun to the Heritage Museum and Village with trick‑or‑treating through historic buildings decorated for the season. Families can enjoy hands‑on crafts, popcorn and cotton candy, games, balloon animals, and a friendly fortune teller ready to add a dash of mystery to the evening. With activities for all ages, the event offers a safe, playful celebration where costumes take center stage and the village comes alive with Halloween cheer.This family-friendly event includes:

title: Plated: A Chef’s Table on Main
description:
In partnership with the Merchants on Main, come celebrate the reopening of Main Street and the grand opening of the 4th Street Plaza by experiencing a beautiful outdoor community table.

Plated: A Chef’s Table is a community dining experience created in collaboration with Rail District businesses, and we believe the best way to bring people together is through good food. Guests will gather on Frisco Main Street to share a memorable meal that highlights the incredible culinary talent found throughout the Rail District, featuring chefs from La Finca, Dad Jokes Cheesyburgers, Didi's Downtown, Randy's Steakhouse, Heritage Table, and Eight 11 Place.

Dine with us and help bring the community together one plate at a time! Thank you to the Rail District partners.

This curated menu will be served as an outdoor dining experience expanding from 5th Street to North County. - Plates are $50 and include a drink; additional drink options will also be available for purchase.- No substitutions to the selected menus. - Each ticket includes a specially created meal and non-alcoholic beverage.- Alcohol available for purchase separately.

**September 28 Update: Simply Thai is no longer available to participate in this event due to a scheduling conflict.

**October 9 Update: La Suprema is no longer available to participate in this event due to a scheduling conflict.

**Reservations must be made by Sunday, 10/11 at 11:59 p.m.**

description:

title: Sidecar Jazz Lounge - Winter 2026
description:
Featured Musicians: Color Nativo

Color Nativo is a musical group that fuses Colombian rhythms, jazz, and Latin American music. Led by Mateo Orozco on guitar and vocals and Catalina Forero on vocals and bass, the project stands out for its lyrical content and interpretative skill. Since its creation, it has gained great popularity in Colombia, Chile, Argentina, Mexico, the United States, and Europe, making live appearances in Houston, Fort Worth, and Dallas, TX.

Thank you to Momo's Coffeehouse for providing refreshments at this concert.

title: Sidecar Jazz Lounge ft. The Furgos
description:
Sidecar Jazz Lounge is back for 2027!

Bring a date, a friend, or fly solo, and prepare to be captivated by jazzy rhythms sure to soothe away your stress! This atmospheric program features live jazz music thoughtfully paired with a delicious signature mocktail by Momo's Coffeehouse.

This month's performance features The Furgos, a jazz ensemble and husband-and-wife duo who share their musical chemistry by blending sophisticated jazz with the familiarity and timeless appeal of popular music.

Jeanette is the lead vocalist, and Jeff is a pianist, composer, arranger, and versatile musician. Together, they have released two albums, Nostalgia and Retrospective, and their third album, First Set, is scheduled for release in early 2027. They have performed throughout North Texas and across the country at venues and festivals including The Kitchen Café, Kimbell Art Museum, Sundance Square, Rudy's Jazz Room in Nashville, and the Jazz at Sledge Festival.

Learn more about them at thefurgos.com.

**Tickets on sale December 1, 2026

title: Learn to Fish
description:
December 21 | 10 a.m. - 12 p.m. | Frisco Heritage Center

Registration Opens November 30 at 5:30 p.m.

Ready to try fishing for the first time? — no experience required! The workshop will focus on basic tackle, rod and reels, basic knot tying, fish habitat, fish identification, fish handling, and fishing ethics and regulations. The workshop is open to children age 5 and up accompanied by an adult. No actual fishing will be done during the class, please do not bring fishing equipment This workshop will be held indoors.

Age: 5 and up. Spots are Extremely Limited.

All attendees must pre-register.
